test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 15 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No almond is a fruit.

Some cashews are almonds.

**Conclusions:**

I. No fruit is an almond.

II. All fruits are cashews.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given according to given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d673a8ec96dd1d1daa50b807271d79f7b87e8fe41c2639eba2b20dd552b072e1.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No fruit is an almond → Follow → (As no almond is a fruit so, no fruit is an almond is definite follow)

II. All fruits are cashews → Does not follow → (As no almond is a fruit and some cashews are almonds so, all fruits are cashews is not definite follow)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
